final_wiki.answer-Q-1282:
Q-1282: What day of the week was 2025-09-17?
Answer: Wednesday

Reasoning: 2025-01-01 is Wednesday. Days from Jan 1 to Sep 17: Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31 = 243 days, plus 17 = 260 days after Jan 1. 260 mod 7 = 1. Wednesday + 1 = Thursday? Let me recheck: 260 = 37*7 + 1, so 260 days after a Wednesday is Thursday.

Wait, let me recount. From Jan 1 (day 0) to Sep 17:
Jan: 31 days (Jan 1 to Jan 31 = 30 days after Jan 1)
Actually, let me count the day-of-year for Sep 17:
Jan 31 + Feb 28 + Mar 31 + Apr 30 + May 31 + Jun 30 + Jul 31 + Aug 31 + Sep 17 = 31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31+17 = 260
So Sep 17 is the 260th day of the year. Jan 1 is day 1 = Wednesday.
(260-1) mod 7 = 259 mod 7 = 37*7 = 259, so 259 mod 7 = 0.
So Sep 17 is the same day as Jan 1 = Wednesday.

Answer: Wednesday
